verdict.rationale: Auth0 Organizations is well documented for representing B2B customers/partners, managing membership, and per-organization branding/connections (auth0-docs-6, -44, -65, -70, -24), plus a dedicated B2B SaaS page describing self-serve customer admin, SSO, and SCIM directory sync (auth0-docs-80, -90). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents invitation flows (e.g., invite-by-email, invitation API/UI) as part of Organizations. Missing for 10: explicit invitation-flow documentation, membership-management API detail, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the full org+invite workflow.
